claim_ceiling: This does not prove an autonomous developmental trigger for creating all useful target capabilities. It does demote the idea that semantic target names or caller-supplied program sequences are required. The remaining seam is the trigger/materialization policy for turning a newly qualified operational distinction into one or more bound request capabilities without smuggling preferred-target choice or minting EFFECT authority.
observed: Projection discovery produces non-empty opaque bucket vocabulary from learned key_to_bucket structure; projection origin is ENDOGENOUS_PROPOSAL_EXTERNALLY_QUALIFIED and carries no semantic desired-state vocabulary.
derive_bound_request_specialization requires an explicit exact target_token argument from that current learned vocabulary.
Qualifying the projection alone does not silently mint target-specialized EFFECT capabilities; materializing one bucket leaves its sibling unmaterialized.
Once both atoms exist, existing lived-history/program owners reconstruct the multi-step sequence without receiving a preferred target/program sequence and with execution authority NONE.
